name: Sleeping under spells
source:
You've been pining for your neighbor for a while, and tonight seems perfect to maybe confess your feelings... That if Alioth wasn't the most dense mage in the region. 

[From [url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/sleepingunderspell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经思念你的邻居有一段时间了，今晚似乎是坦白你的感受的最佳时机……如果阿利奥斯不是该地区最密集的法师的话。

[来自[url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/sleepingunderspell]Itch.io[/url]]
